name: worker-bindings-lab
description: Fictional Cloudflare Worker used as a real @velajs/cloudflare example project.

scripts.sync:deps: pnpm run build:vela && pnpm run build:cloudflare && pnpm install
scripts.build: pnpm run sync:deps && rm -rf dist && swc src -d dist --strip-leading-paths && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run sync:deps && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
